summary: Kimi Antonelli led from start to finish at the Circuit of the Americas, converting pole position into a commanding victory that left him just two points shy of the championship crown. The Mercedes driver controlled the race with precision through the high-speed corners of Austin, never allowing his challengers a genuine opportunity to mount a serious challenge. With two races remaining, Antonelli stands on the verge of becoming F1's youngest world champion, needing merely a handful of points to end the season mathematically.
